prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent game sprite atlas for a cozy cat room.
Create ONE landscape atlas with precisely four equal columns and three equal rows, 11 separate small home objects; the last bottom-right cell is empty. No grid lines or cell backgrounds. All objects and their shadows must stay inside their own cell with at least 12% transparent margin. True transparent alpha background; no opaque paper rectangle.
Input reference roles: reference images 1 and 2 are the original illustrated sunny/rainy room, reference images 3 and 4 are matching existing furniture sprites. MATCH those originals' gouache-paper illustration, elegant simple silhouettes, pale creamy yellow, light blond wood, muted sage mint, soft warm peach pink, colored geometric shadow planes, very fine subtle paper grain, gently rounded 2.5D volume. Objects should feel painted and dimensional, not flat vector icons. Restrained material cues on fabric, yarn, ceramic, wood. Warm upper-left light with softly shaded right/lower planes. Not glossy photoreal 3D.
EXACT row-major content:
Row 1 col 1: one small cat teaser wand, light wooden stick slanted diagonally with a delicate short cord and a muted sage feather; whole wand fits cell. Row 1 col 2: one soft warm-peach yarn ball with winding yarn texture and tiny loose tail. Row 1 col 3: one shallow cream ceramic bowl containing two tiny dried fish, viewed slightly above, thick rounded rim and shaded lower side. Row 1 col 4: one tiny plush muted sage mouse cat toy with peach ears and fine curved tail, low rounded body.
Row 2 col 1: one soft square sage fabric throw cushion, slightly tilted, subtle fabric seams and broad gentle shaded sides. Row 2 col 2: one small cream ceramic flowerpot with several rounded sage leaves, complete pot and leaves, no extras. Row 2 col 3: one THIN small oval woven pale-sage floor rug lying flat on the ground in shallow perspective, broad horizontally and very low, no raised pad thickness, no pillow shape. Row 2 col 4: one slim pale-yellow crescent moon wall hanging with its single fine hanging cord extending vertically above it.
Row 3 col 1: one short vertical hanging garland of three small pale golden stars, connected by a delicate fine string including visible top suspension string. Row 3 col 2: one pale muted-blue raindrop ornament with a delicate vertical top hanging cord and soft shaded side. Row 3 col 3: one small wall art in a slim pale wooden rounded rectangular frame, featuring one simple muted-peach/sage/cream rainbow on cream paper, framed picture only, no text. Row 3 col 4: entirely empty transparent.
No labels, text, lettering, grid, backdrop, borders around cells, added props, shiny highlights, heavy outlines, black strokes, characters, furniture, or scene. Keep all eleven objects clearly separated. Make high-quality illustrated room objects, not UI buttons.
packing: Chrome Canvas lossless grid extraction and alpha-content crop only. Pixel alpha preserved; 8px transparent margin added. No background removal or recoloring.
